mapper.select: SELECT SCREEN_ID, NAME, CAPACITY, GRID_COLUMNS, GRID_ROWS FROM T_SCREEN WHERE SCREEN_ID = #{screenId}
SELECT SCREEN_SEAT_ID, SEAT_NO, GRID_X, GRID_Y, SEAT_TYPE, USE_YN FROM T_SCREEN_SEAT WHERE SCREEN_ID = #{screenId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY GRID_Y, GRID_X
SELECT GRID_X, GRID_Y, GRID_WIDTH, GRID_HEIGHT FROM T_SCREEN_LAYOUT_OBJECT WHERE SCREEN_ID = #{screenId} AND OBJECT_TYPE = 'SCREEN' AND NAME = 'MAIN'
mapper.update: UPDATE T_SCREEN SET GRID_COLUMNS = #{gridColumns}, GRID_ROWS = #{gridRows} WHERE SCREEN_ID = #{screenId}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO T_SCREEN_LAYOUT_OBJECT T USING (SELECT #{screenId} AS SCREEN_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (T.SCREEN_ID = S.SCREEN_ID AND T.OBJECT_TYPE = 'SCREEN' AND T.NAME = 'MAIN') WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.GRID_X = #{screenX}, T.GRID_Y = #{screenY}, T.GRID_WIDTH = #{screenWidth}, T.GRID_HEIGHT = #{screenHeight} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (LAYOUT_OBJECT_ID, SCREEN_ID, OBJECT_TYPE, NAME, GRID_X, GRID_Y, GRID_WIDTH, GRID_HEIGHT) VALUES (SCREEN_LAYOUT_OBJECT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{screenId}, 'SCREEN', 'MAIN', #{screenX}, #{screenY}, #{screenWidth}, #{screenHeight})

INTO T_SCREEN_SEAT (SCREEN_SEAT_ID, SCREEN_ID, SEAT_NO, GRID_X, GRID_Y, SEAT_TYPE, USE_YN) VALUES (#{seat.screenSeatId}, #{screenId}, #{seat.seatNo}, #{seat.gridX}, #{seat.gridY}, #{seat.seatType}, 'Y')
